design_note: docs/ORIGIN_OF_LIFE_ENGINE_DESIGN.md: §0.1, §0.2a (the lead's rulings, amended 17 November 2026: the last molecule's rate is the pair rule in its cancelled form, in either direction), §2.1-2.4, §3.3, §7.1-7.2

conventions.rule: every bundle and probe declares every token; a missing or unknown token is refused (status 2)

amendments.what: world ol1_boundary and its probe states (role boundary_probe, row OL1-1): §0.2a's extinct rule in the forward direction; anti-parallel two-cycles added to the Kolmogorov check
amendments.why: ol1_wa reaches the extinct boundary only through the reverse of a join

amendments.what: the harness enforces the registered sizes: 2,000 runs per rung (row OL1-4b) and 500 events per rescale run (row OL1-3b), as it does the ledger run's 2,000 events
amendments.why: a smaller submission would otherwise be judged at a power the design never registered

amendments.what: the harness requires every per-pair role to hold exactly the two probed convention pairs, once each, and the ledger run to save the registered rows (every 100 events, and the last)
amendments.why: one pair alone, or a ledger run that saves row 0 only, would otherwise pass vacuously

amendments.what: amendment 4: (a) §0.2a as amended: the cancelled form wherever the membrane factor is 0/0, under every last_molecule token, and kept zeroing only pairs with an empty end state; the kernel probe gains each membrane step's reactant-only and product-only states (592 states); the superseded reading is planted (empty_m_zero). (b) §0.2b rule 8: world_role = probe on the worlds holding r4 (ol1_wa, ol1_wa_closed and its two variants); a tenth refusal; the probe's expectation is +inf at r4's singular pair under multinomial_less_one. (c) runs declare an end_reason, and a registered run that ends stalled fails its row
amendments.why: the lead's rulings of 17 November (§0.2a amended; §0.2b rule 8)

amendments.what: amendment 5, text only: kept's meaning reworded to the lead's ruling (main bbcbec69): rate zero only for a pair whose step changes the membrane's count and one of whose end states has an empty membrane; a step in which the membrane takes no part, and a pool step at an empty-membrane probe state, fire at their own rates; rule 8's condition cited as the same membrane species on both sides. The reference law and float path test the count condition explicitly; every registered expected value is unchanged (checked bitwise on every registered probe, all four token pairs)
amendments.why: the lead confirmed both of OL5's readings (bbcbec69)

worlds.refusals: designs/refusals/*.world.json: each must be refused at parse

OL1-1.claim: every channel keeps local detailed balance (§0.1, §7.1)

inputs.states: probes.kernel_probe_states (written by make-probes; echoed by the engine)

checks: Kolmogorov on every registered square and two-cycle (convention-free)
ln a-(n') - ln a+(n) = F(n') - F(n) - w under the declared tokens
reverse rates equal the reference's (the extinct boundary's continued form included)
OL1-1.tolerance: 64 u (8 + Sum|ln a|) per cycle; 64 u (4 + |ln a+| + |ln a-| + |DeltaF|) per edge
planted: a literal zero for the last molecule's rate under extinct
zero for +inf at the singular pair (amendment 4)

registered_magnitudes.check: the largest |residual| of the named check over the registered probe, under (multinomial, kept); re-derived at amendment 4 on the amended law and the 592-state probe

extent_offset.note: an error under c = 0 only; under c = 1 it is the rule

wrong_last_molecule_token.reverse_rates: zero pattern differs at the boundary states

empty_m_zero.forward_form: zero-pattern mismatch at 3 entries (reference rates >= 0.5 per s)

singular_as_zero.forward_form: one singular-pattern mismatch, and one in the reverse rates, under multinomial_less_one

OL1-2.claim: a closed world relaxes to exp(-F/k_BT) (§7.1)

inputs.states: probes.closed_world_states from the world's initial state (387 states)

checks: exact edge identity in the reference (RatExp)
the engine table's stationary law against exp(-F)/Z
Kolmogorov on every square of the closed world

registered_magnitudes.check: total variation of the planted table's stationary law from exp(-F)/Z on ol1_wa_closed

checks: both closed-world tables relax to exp(-F)/Z
identical channel sequence, times exactly halved (bitwise)
planted: the factor on forward channels only

a_forward_form.check: a+ equals k g(m) E(m) theta+(n) under the declared tokens

b_large_system.cut: the state after the last event at or before each time
b_large_system.streams: independent, one per run; none shared
b_large_system.null: the exact master-equation mean on each rung (not the ODE)
b_large_system.test: two-sided z on each mean, Bonferroni over 16 (z = 4.003)

planted: reverse channels selected at 0.9 of their weight

checks: every moiety conserved at every row, held exchange counted from the trace

OL1-5.claim: the ledgers for reactions close: F(n_t) - F(n_0) = W_t - Q_t at every row (§3.3)

run.fission: none (no fission threshold is reached, or none declared)

OL1-5.tolerance: 2 [16 u E (1 + L) + gamma_E (Sum|q| + Sum|w|) + 4 u (|F_t| + |F_0|)] (ledger.py)

OL1-6.claim: streams: bitwise replay; distinct identities share no uniforms (§7.1)
